query: William Pery served as Captain of the Yeomen of the Guard under the lord who served in what position from 1865 to 1868?

pipeline_result.response: Based on the information provided, William Pery served as a Captain of the Yeomanry of the Guard during the time period from 1865 to 1868. He was appointed by the Governor General of the United States of America, General James W. Knoxville, as a Lieutenant-General in 1864 and later became a Lieutenant-General in 1867.
